Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning government entities photographing or recording images of citizens.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to government entities photographing or recordingimages of citizens; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 36.01 RCW; adding a new section to chapter46.63 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A city or town may not photograph or record images of a persondriving a vehicle or of passengers in the vehicle. (2) A city or town may not photograph or record images of a vehicleor vehicle license plate except as expressly authorized by statute. (3) For purposes of this section, "photograph" or "record" meansthe making of a photograph, microphotograph, a videotape, an electronicimage, or other recorded images.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A county may not photograph or record images of a persondriving a vehicle or of passengers in the vehicle. p. 1 SB 6295 (2) A county may not photograph or record images of a vehicle orvehicle license plate except as expressly authorized by statute. (3) For purposes of this section, "photograph" or "record" meansthe making of a photograph, microphotograph, a videotape, an electronicimage, or other recorded images.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.63 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state of Washington fully occupies and preempts the entirefield of regulation over photo enforcement systems and automatedtraffic safety cameras. Cities, towns, and counties, or othermunicipalities, may adopt only those laws and ordinances relating tophoto enforcement systems and automated traffic safety cameras that areconsistent with this chapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department may not photograph or record images of a persondriving a vehicle on any state highway or of passengers in the vehicle. (2) The department may not photograph or record images of a vehicleor vehicle license plate except as expressly authorized by statute. (3) For purposes of this section, "photograph" or "record" meansthe making of a photograph, microphotograph, a videotape, an electronicimage, or other recorded images.
